messages:
jordan (support): customer @AcmeReports reporting lots of 504s and 'gateway timeout' on hosted inference since ~03:50 UTC. They see errors when traffic spikes. billing hit, escalated from CSM.
sam (oncall): assigning. can you paste example request/resp and top-level metrics? tx.
jordan (support): here's sample API error: `POST /v1/generate -> 504 Gateway Timeout` response body: `\{\"error\":\"gateway timeout\"}`. Customer says latency was fine until a burst then lots of 5xx. Attached their request ID: `req_8f3a`.
lisa (product-support): same customer on Dedicated before, now on Hosted. They hit bursty nightly reports (~600 rps => 20s window). We saw quota bump yesterday.
deploy-bot: deploy finished: inference-runtime@2026-03-15T03:30Z by rahul (canary 5%).
alex (eng-sre): looking at infra: cluster autoscale shows pod startup time spiking. KEDA logs indicate scaler returned 0 for several polls while HPA didn't scale fast enough. suspect scale-up lag + warmup.
rahul (eng-runtime): on it. pulling logs: gateway backend responses show `upstream timed out (110)`. Model pods are getting scheduled but readiness probes failing for ~45-70s due to model init and kv cache priming.
jordan (support): customer complaint includes screenshot of token billing spikes and retries causing higher cost.
sam (oncall): can we reproduce? rahul, any known change in model image or init that increased cold-start time? rahul (eng-runtime): no recent model image changes. but we did increase the security sidecar (kms agent) in the image last week, adds 6-8s to startup. combined with large model quant files (~600MB) pulled from S3 on init -> adds variable time.
alex (eng-sre): KEDA config: `pollingInterval: 30s, cooldownPeriod: 300s, minReplicaCount: 0`. HPA has `minReplicas: 1`? Actually HPA target CPU set to 70% but our inference pods sit idle while queue grows because initial CPU spike is masked by readiness probe not open.
lisa (product-support): summary: burst -> queue backlog -> KEDA polls detect metric -> KEDA tries to scale but minReplicaCount=0 plus KEDA cooldown/polling delays -> HPA doesn't kick fast enough because pods not ready -> gateway times out -> 504s.
rahul (eng-runtime): repro steps I ran locally: (1) flood gateway with 300 concurrent small requests over 20s; (2) watch `kubectl get pods -w` -> new pods SCHEDULED then CONTAINER_CREATING -> IMAGE_PULL -> RUNNING -> but `readiness` stays `False` for 40-90s while model loads. gateway returns 502/504 after 15s upstream timeout.
alex (eng-sre): logs from KEDA: `time="2026-03-15T03:51:12Z" level=info msg="Scaler returned 0"` repeated for two polls, then `ScaledObject: no change`. HPA events show `ScalingReplicaSet up from 1 to 3` but pod readiness delay caused effective capacity=0 for 60s.
sam (oncall): immediate mitigation ideas?
rahul (eng-runtime): short term: patch deployment to set `minReplicaCount: 2` (ScaledObject) and `HPA minReplicas: 2` to avoid cold start on bursts. Also increase gateway upstream timeout to 90s and extend readiness probe initialDelaySeconds to accommodate deterministic init. long term: pre-warm model cache and move heavy init to initContainer that pulls model artifact.
alex (eng-sre): agree. also lower KEDA `pollingInterval` to 5s for critical routes and reduce `cooldownPeriod` to 60s. Another quick patch: `kubectl scale deploy inference-runtime --replicas=4` to immediately add capacity for this customer while we patch configs.
jordan (support): customer wants ETA and whether we can stop billing spikes. they asked for temporary reserved capacity. we can offer burst reserved and manual scaling.
lisa (product-support): coordinating with sales to offer credit for the billing spike. pls confirm fix timeline.
rahul (eng-runtime): I'll run immediate `kubectl scale` and patch ScaledObject. command I'm about to run: ```
kubectl scale deployment inference-runtime --replicas=4 -n prod
kubectl patch scaledobject inference-runtime-scaledobject -n prod --type='merge' -p '{"spec":{"minReplicaCount":2, "pollingInterval":5}}'
``` 
sam (oncall): go ahead. note: watch for image pull rate limits. if nodes need images, cluster may stall on pull and still produce 504s.
rahul (eng-runtime): scaled and patched. KEDA poll interval now 5s. scaled up to 4 replicas. watching.
sre-bot: alert auto-resolve: queue-depth for route `/v1/generate` dropped from 820 -> 90 in 45s.
alex (eng-sre): after scale we see new pods become ready at ~30-45s, upstream errors drop to near zero. Gateway 504s stop for the moment. However backlog still leads to some retries client-side causing cost.
jordan (support): relaying to customer: we scaled them and patched scaler; should see improvement. asking if they'd like a temporary reserved pool.
lisa (product-support): ok offer sent. also request engineering action items: (1) pre-warm initContainer for model pull, (2) add configurable `minReplicaCount` per plan, (3) reduce gateway upstream timeout only for non-interactive routes.
rahul (eng-runtime): creating a runbook PR with steps to mitigate scale-up lag: include commands, recommended values for `minReplicaCount`, `pollingInterval`, `cooldownPeriod`, and a snippet for an initContainer that pre-pulls model artifacts.
alex (eng-sre): follow-up: need metrics dashboard for "effective ready capacity" (sum of ready replicas weighted by avg concurrency) so product can detect when capacity is non-ideal before 5xxs.
sam (oncall): assignment: rahul to implement initContainer prototype and runbook; alex to add dashboard alert; jordan/lisa to coordinate customer comms and credits. escalate to eng-platform if we need infra quotas/reserved nodes.
rahul (eng-runtime): patch PR: `PR#4123` opened with initContainer snippet and note to move heavy KMS init earlier. I'll run tests in staging then roll to prod with 10% canary.
deploy-bot: canary rollout started for inference-runtime@2026-03-15T04:20Z.
alex (eng-sre): monitor for 2 hours, if any >5xx spike re-open postmortem. adding incident label and duration.
jordan (support): customer confirmed errors dropped within 2min after scaling, still monitoring. thanked us.
sam (oncall): closing slack thread when we verify 2hrs stable. great response team :thumbsup:
rahul (eng-runtime): postmortem checklist created, linking logs and commands under ticket INF-2199. will include cost impact estimate and recommended product changes.
sre-bot: incident INF-2199 created by sam (oncall)
jordan (support): adding note: ask billing to exclude retry-charge for this window and follow up with customer."
